GithubSigninConnection.description: Device-flow sign-in state (docs/GITHUB_DEVICE_FLOW_PLAN.md, C5). In operator_token mode it is always `{"mode":"operator_token","signin_available":false,"state":"disconnected","repositories_truncated":false}`; the operator's token is described by the integration's own state.

signin_available.description: False without a configured GitHub App client ID, in operator_token mode, or while Helm shuts down.

login.description: GitHub login of the connected account. Absent when never connected.

install_url.description: Installation page of Helm's GitHub App on https://github.com. Absent without a configured App slug.

authorizations_url.description: Where the user revokes Helm's authorization on GitHub.

repositories_truncated.description: GitHub reported more repositories than Helm reads (at most 50).

GithubSigninAttempt.description: The one sign-in attempt. Absent (never null) when there is none.

user_code.description: Sent only to the administrator who began the attempt, and only while it is pending.

message.description: Helm's own sentence for an ended attempt; empty while pending.

attempt_id.description: A stale ID changes nothing, so an old tab cannot cancel a newer attempt.
